t: That section 810 of the Housing Act of 1964 is amended by striking out “three-year period” and inserting in lieu thereof “six-year period”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment extending a time period in section 810 of the Housing Act of 1964 from three years to six. It creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. A tempting reading is that the underlying program may involve outside parties, but nothing in this section's text brings any non-federal party into a federal decision.
fable.s: is amended by striking out “three-year period” and inserting in lieu thereof “six-year period”

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple textual amendment to a statute, changing a time period from three years to six years.
